one_liner: Senior executive (SES) who leads GSA's real estate strategy for client agencies, shaping office space solutions and representing PBS to Congress, OMB and agency leaders.
fit_summary: This SES role requires senior leadership in federal real property acquisition (lease, purchase, construction) and executive management of people and budgets. Daniel's resume shows neither, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to all U.S. citizens (public and SES hiring paths), so no federal status is needed.
Your two-page resume must clearly show all three Mandatory Technical Competencies, including senior leadership in acquiring real property by lease, purchase or construction for client agencies.
Your resume must also demonstrate all five Executive Core Qualifications. Separate narratives will not be reviewed.

The role requires a Top Secret clearance before appointment, though you do not need one to apply. It also requires a drug test, an OGE 278 financial disclosure, and OPM QRB certification of your executive qualifications.
